scope: This additive route changes the wrapper to GeometryCollection while retaining the same two atomic Polygon components. It does not make the original overlapping MultiPolygon valid and is not a MultiPolygon compatibility gain.

case.name: planar_overlapping_geometrycollection
case.component_sum_rule: Each 4x4 component contributes independently; the overlap is counted twice.

physical_workflow_v3.description: Wave71 planar EPSG4326 GeometryCollection composition v3
physical_workflow_v3.geometry_edge_model: Every edge-bearing input and both Polygon children are explicitly planar (geodesic:false); no coordinates or components are transformed.
physical_workflow_v3.change_from_v2: The sixth row wraps the same two atomic Polygon components as the rejected v2 overlapping MultiPolygon in a GeometryCollection. This separate input shape is a positive composition test, not a compatibility gain for MultiPolygon.
physical_workflow_v3.map_behavior: FeatureCollection.map computes only explicit EPSG:4326 Geometry/Feature area, length, perimeter and centroid. It returns the actual projected Feature centroid with computed properties so the physical CSV .geo and original identity/properties are read back.
